caseNameFull: Allen v. Ellisor, Chairman, South Carolina Election Commission

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Certio-rari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded with directions to consider whether the case has become moot by-reason of the enactment of Act R 655, effective March 20, 1981, whereby § 7-5-120(5)(b) of the South Carolina Code of Laws (1976) was amended. See Crowell v. Mader, 444 U. S. 505 (1980).
